column1: # i18n manifest — ja/ is the source of truth, targets are generated artifacts.
# Columns: source (relative to ja/) <TAB> target (relative to repo root) <TAB> class <TAB> flags
#   class  translate          = translate the whole file
#          translate-comments = translate comments and user-facing strings only; never touch code
#          copy               = copy verbatim (no prose in the file)
#          code-identical     = check-i18n.sh enforces byte-identical code lines (non-comment, non-echo)
#          root-readme        = generated at the repository root; relative doc links must be prefixed with en/
